question.prompt: Isabella’s house has \(3\) bedrooms. Each bedroom is \(12\) feet long, \(10\) feet wide, and \(8\) feet high. Isabella must paint the walls of all the bedrooms. Doorways and windows, which will not be painted, occupy \(60\) square feet in each bedroom. How many square feet of walls must be painted?

solutions.explanation:
Find the paintable area of one bedroom, then multiply by \(3\). Each bedroom has two walls measuring \(12\) feet by \(8\) feet and two measuring \(10\) feet by \(8\) feet. Their total area is
\[
2(12\cdot8)+2(10\cdot8)=352
\]
square feet. Subtracting the doorways and windows leaves \(352-60=292\) square feet to paint in each bedroom. Thus the total is
\[
3\cdot292=876
\]
square feet, choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
solutions.title: Add the wall areas
